items.text: Fixed ambient lights staying on after a base streams back in, reducing unnecessary lighting and improving performance.
Corrected gravestone collider to use the intended convex shape, fixing unexpected physics impacts when interacting with gravestones.
Removed an unused mesh collider and fixed layer issues on the Cursed Cauldron, preventing incorrect building collisions and physics glitches.
Assigned proper physics materials to Wooden Cross, Skull Fire Pit, and Spooky Speaker, ensuring correct collision behavior.
Prevented jumping while crouched under a solid object, stopping the head from clipping through floors and avoiding unintended explosion damage.
Fixed the Frankenstein pet ignoring player shields, allowing shields to protect against its attacks as intended.
NPC corpses are now lootable after a server restart, restoring expected loot drops from dead enemies.
Ensured scarecrows always spawn in all Halloween dungeon corridors, fixing missing enemy spawns.
Radiation no longer starts immediately upon entering Halloween and Christmas dungeons, giving players time to react after entry.
Fixed cooking workbench not showing the kettle when preparing newly added teas.
Added a second CaveNetworkGroupLayerOverride to the nuclear missile silo to cover living quarters and computer room, fixing players and NPCs disappearing/reappearing on stairs.
Added new DungeonGridBlocker to canyon areas to prevent underground train tunnels from generating too close and removing terrain collision, preventing rare deaths at canyon bottoms.
Added two new side anchors to cliff_tall_slope_l_a to fix gaps in the geometry.
Fixed Frankenstein pet sinking in terrain, invisible ranged attacks, occasional kicking of the owner, and moving through windows.
Fixed flickering mouse cursor when scrolling UI options with the right stick and resolved double hover state.
Fixed container order when jumping with bumpers in D‑pad mode.
Fixed gamepad glyph display panel UI overlapping in inventory on certain resolutions/aspects.
Fixed artifacting on cargo mapmarker.
Fixed MeshCull not hiding its renderer when reused from the pool while culled, preventing code lock light quads from drawing at any distance.
Fixed ParticleSystemCull playing particle systems at any distance when turned on, fixing conveyor flashing and furnace heat shimmers, and saving 0.15 ms on the particle main thread.
Fixed a swarm of loose bees briefly appearing near the hand when throwing a bee grenade.
Fixed badly merged animation controllers and livestock FSM.
Added missing IsOn check for helicopter rumble.
Fixed cooking workbench not showing the kettle for new teas and added a dedicated craftable list with an “All” button and toggle‑group category navigation.

Added a second CaveNetworkGroupLayerOverride to the nuclear missile silo to stop players and NPCs disappearing on stairs, introduced DungeonGridBlocker to canyon tunnels to prevent unsafe underground train tunnels, and made all lighthouses share resource and repair progress for unified upkeep.
Fixed Frankenstein pet sinking in terrain, invisible ranged attacks, occasional kicking of the owner, and passing through windows.
Adjusted coconut tree spawn mechanics (range, 25% chance, removed spawns on certain palms) and increased apple and beehive spawn chances on oak trees.
Resolved artifacting on cargo map markers.
Fixed MeshCull reuse bug that caused code lock light indicators to render at any distance after spawning.

2026-10-19.summary:
### Crafting & Cooking
- Fixed cooking workbench not showing the kettle for new teas and added a dedicated craftable list with an “All” button and toggle‑group category navigation.

### Structures & World Safety
- Added a second CaveNetworkGroupLayerOverride to the nuclear missile silo to stop players and NPCs disappearing on stairs, introduced DungeonGridBlocker to canyon tunnels to prevent unsafe underground train tunnels, and made all lighthouses share resource and repair progress for unified upkeep.

### Pets & Companions
- Fixed Frankenstein pet sinking in terrain, invisible ranged attacks, occasional kicking of the owner, and passing through windows.

### Environment & Resources
- Adjusted coconut tree spawn mechanics (range, 25% chance, removed spawns on certain palms) and increased apple and beehive spawn chances on oak trees.

### Map & Navigation
- Resolved artifacting on cargo map markers.

### Security & Code Locks
- Fixed MeshCull reuse bug that caused code lock light indicators to render at any distance after spawning.

items.text: Headshot sound now matches the actual direction, fixing reversed left/right audio cues.
Seeds planted outside planters now display correct gene information in the UI.
Sheep can now be loaded onto small modules even when also leading a cow.

2026-10-18.summary:
### Combat Audio
- Headshot sound now matches the actual direction, fixing reversed left/right audio cues.

### Farming & UI
- Seeds planted outside planters now display correct gene information in the UI.

### Vehicle & Animal Transport
- Sheep can now be loaded onto small modules even when also leading a cow.
